headline: Ruble Rises Amid Market Optimism
summary: The ruble rose against the dollar and euro on Monday as markets grew optimistic about settling the Ukraine crisis after a Putin-Trump phone call.
why: The ruble is Russia's currency, and its moves reflect investor views on sanctions, geopolitics and energy revenues.

impacts.name: Russian ruble
impacts.why: Optimism over a possible settlement of the Ukraine conflict increases demand for the ruble against the dollar and euro.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investor optimism about a possible settlement of the Ukraine conflict, following a Putin-Trump phone call, lifted the ruble.
